nodes.description: uint256 public id: ERC1155 token id being auctioned (set to 51 in constructor)
address public token: ERC1155 contract address used in safeTransferFrom calls
bool public ended: auction finalization flag, set true in end() and pull()
uint256 public startBidTime: unix timestamp when bidding opens
address payable public haus: recipient of the 15% protocol fee
address payable public seller: recipient of proceeds / NFT on failed auction
uint256 public bidLength: anti-sniping extension window (20.5 hours)
uint256 public auctionLength: total auction duration (20.5 hours)
uint256 public lastBid: current highest bid amount, also refunded to previous bidder
uint256 public lastBidTime: timestamp of the most recent bid
address payable public winning: current highest bidder, receives refund and the NFT
constructor(): initializes token, id, startBidTime, lastBid, seller and haus
bid() payable: validates bid window and bid size, refunds previous winner, then records new bid
end(): finalizes auction, transfers ERC1155 to winner, splits ETH between haus and seller
pull(): returns ERC1155 to seller when no bids were placed
live() external view: returns whether the auction is still active based on timestamps
onERC1155Received(): ERC1155 receiver hook invoked during safeTransferFrom callbacks
msg.sender: caller address used as bidder identity and winner
tx.origin: used in bid() as a 'no contracts' gate, enabling phishing/EOA-spoof bypass
block.timestamp: drives every auction timing decision (bid window, end, pull, live)
winning.transfer(lastBid): external ETH refund executed before lastBid/winning/lastBidTime are updated
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(...) in end(): external call that can invoke the receiver's onERC1155Received hook before ended=true
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(...) in pull(): external call to seller triggering receiver callback
haus.transfer(hausFee): external ETH payment of the 15% protocol fee
seller.transfer(address(this).balance): external ETH payment of remaining proceeds
lastBid.mul(105).div(100): arithmetic computing the minimum accepted bid (rounding/overflow surface)
balance.div(20).mul(3): arithmetic computing the haus fee (integer division truncation)
local variable balance: cached contract balance inside end()
local variable hausFee: computed protocol fee inside end()

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in bid() to record the bidder/winner and is trusted as the refund recipient
bid() requires msg.sender == tx.origin, an origin-based authorization check that can be bypassed via phishing or intermediary contracts
block.timestamp gates whether a bid is accepted and whether the anti-sniping window is still open
block.timestamp decides whether end() may finalize the auction (miner-controllable)
block.timestamp decides whether pull() may return the NFT to the seller
live() derives its result entirely from block.timestamp comparisons
bid() performs an external ETH refund to the previous winner before updating lastBid, winning and lastBidTime (checks-effects-interactions violation)
the stored winning address is the destination of the refund transfer
the stored lastBid amount is the value of the refund transfer
lastBid feeds the mul(105).div(100) minimum-bid arithmetic
bid() evaluates msg.value against the computed minimum bid, an arithmetic comparison that can revert or misprice
bid() writes lastBid = msg.value
bid() writes lastBidTime = block.timestamp
bid() writes winning = msg.sender
end() invokes an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom before setting ended = true and before draining balances
safeTransferFrom invokes the receiver's onERC1155Received hook, an external callback controllable by the receiver
pull() invokes an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom before marking the auction ended
safeTransferFrom invokes onERC1155Received on the receiving party during pull()
end() computes the fee with balance.div(20).mul(3), an order-dependent integer arithmetic expression
the cached balance local is the operand of the fee arithmetic
the cached balance is forwarded to the seller transfer
the computed hausFee local is the value sent to the haus address
end() executes the haus fee transfer
end() performs a second external ETH transfer to the seller while the contract still holds funds and ended is not yet set
the stored haus address is the recipient of the protocol fee
the stored seller address is the recipient of the remaining proceeds
end() writes ended = true
pull() writes ended = true
constructor initializes the token address
constructor initializes startBidTime
constructor sets the initial lastBid reserve price
constructor initializes the seller address
constructor initializes the haus address
constructor initializes the ERC1155 token id
auctionLength bounds the bid acceptance window
bidLength bounds the last-minute bid extension check
lastBidTime determines whether a previous bid exists and must be refunded
bidLength participates in end() finalization timing
auctionLength participates in end() finalization timing
lastBidTime is used to decide whether end() may run
startBidTime is used in the end() timing condition
startBidTime is used in the pull() timing condition
bidLength is used by live()
auctionLength is used by live()
lastBidTime is used by live()
the token address is the target of the ERC1155 call in end()
the token address is the target of the ERC1155 call in pull()
the token id is transferred in end()
the token id is transferred in pull()
the winning address receives the ERC1155 token in end()
the seller address receives the ERC1155 token in pull()

normalization_plan.reason: the local balance is only an intermediate cache used to compute balance.div(20).mul(3) and the seller payout, so it folds into the fee arithmetic unsafe operation
hausFee exists only to hold the value passed to haus.transfer, so it normalizes into that unsafe transfer operation
